name: AFortAIPawn::SetDBNO
notes: bool bOld = IsDBNO(); if (bOld == bNewDBNO) return; set the DBNO bit in the state byte (+0x53a bit 0x2); if entering DBNO broadcast OnPlayerStartDBNO; then broadcast OnDBNOStateChanged(this, new state). The delegate broadcast is FMulticastScriptDelegate::ProcessMulticastDelegate (0x1406a9dc0).
